INPUT

RECORDED OUTPUT

HOW THE BRANCHES RELATE

Two scientific tracks.
Explain the targets

01 · HISTORICAL ACQUISITION

Predict → select → reveal saved labels

Five overlapping chemical-system splits, five policies and 50 historical queries per policy/split. Predictions precede each recorded batch of ten label reveals; this is separate from fresh crystal generation.

Historical signed hull targets

Near-stable: target ≤0.05 eV/atom. On/below reference hull: target ≤0. These outcomes are historical retrieval labels.

Replay the saved acquisition →

02 · FRESH STRUCTURES AND VALIDATION

Generate → screen → inspect separate branches
Six new-to-reference formulas

48 transformer draws → exact-cell gate

0 eligible. This path ends before fresh candidate DFT. Twelve larger-cell diagnostics stay excluded.

Predetermined known-MgO control

Saved generated MgO → CHGNet → QE and compatible source references

Known-phase recovery. The control follows its own planned branch; it is not a successful new-formula discovery.

Four prepared prototype baselines

Prototype substitution → CHGNet relaxation

Four converged model baselines. Their convergence adds no successes to the transformer’s 0/48 yield.

Inspect real saved structures →
Keep the targets distinct. Historical signed hull-distance labels and fresh QE total energies are different quantities. The website does not combine them into interchangeable feedback, retrain a predictor, generate crystals or submit calculations.

Preliminary expectation confused requested390px viewport with375px document width after15px native scrollbar. Final layout observation has equal375px document/scroll widths and no horizontal overflow.
A temporary HTTPS cache-only Clear-Site-Data response invalidated primed testing cache; steady root230B and child156B configs restored and final homepage passed.

verificationLimits: Available in-app browser only, with desktop/mobile viewports; no physical-device or unavailable-browser certification.

Actual downloaded original image sample matched its frozen hash; all26 saved-stage fallback images and three Findings figures passed the application hash loader. No blanket remote-body SHA assertion for every88 release files.
File Manager observations establish physical paths and displayed-size consistency; they are not independent remote SHA proof.
Browser console and visible resource URLs were inspected, not a packet-level every-response TLS audit.
W7 traversed six paused/manual tour scenes; the full180second timed rehearsal remains the preserved W6 result.
